recommendation.thresholdSummary: Critical threshold crossed: Tornado Warning covering the facility, with a Tornado Watch through the morning commute
recommendation.explanation: A Tornado Warning covering downtown Kansas City, including the office, is in effect until 5:30 AM, and a Tornado Watch runs until 11 AM as a second line of storms is forecast to cross the metro between 6 and 9 AM. Anyone already on site should shelter in place now. With tornado-producing storms possible through the morning commute and early reports of downed trees and power lines downtown, the office should close; telework-ready employees can work remotely once the storms pass.
recommendation.whatCouldChange: The watch being cancelled early and an inspection clearing the building and access routes by 9 AM would support a late opening. Confirmed damage to the building would keep it closed.

alerts.headline: At 4:41 AM a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado was near Kansas City, Kansas, moving east at 45 mph. Radar indicated rotation. Take cover now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor.
Conditions are favorable for tornadoes, damaging wind gusts to 70 mph, and hail up to 2 inches through late morning.

forecast.shortForecast: Storms ending by 11 AM, then breezy

roads.detail: Downed trees and power lines reported downtown and standing water at underpasses. Crews are responding; routes will be reassessed after 9 AM.
